development.scope: Conservative complete-original-span support; parent expansion changes context coverage and volume. Shared query embeddings, not independent latency comparisons.

interpretation: Parent expansion may improve coverage by returning more surrounding text. Report budgeted and raw metrics, unexpanded child control, tokens and repeated-source-position redundancy together.
label_policy: Original human-reviewed labels retained. Complete source-span coverage required; partial same-source child is not automatically relevant.

structure.definition: Body characters and fixed tokenizer tokens; full serialized context including headings and trailing delimiters is reported separately. Duplicate rate counts excess identical body hashes within each layer.

test.scope: Conservative complete-original-span support; parent expansion changes context coverage and volume. Shared query embeddings, not independent latency comparisons.

timing_policy: One actual query embedding shared across base/child indices and derived parent contexts. Individual model requests are not independent per method. No latency/QPS improvement claim.
